evidence.title: GitHub - cathrynlavery/diagram-design: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi.

name: Diagram Design
summary: Agent skill that draws 44 diagram types as one self-contained HTML + SVG file, matched to your brand.
description: One skill installed with npx skills add for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and other hosts. It picks a diagram type - architecture, flowchart, sequence, quadrant, sankey and more - and writes a single self-contained HTML + SVG file in minimal light, minimal dark or full-editorial variants, placed by the agent on a 4px grid. It can pull your site's palette and fonts for brand matching, imports Mermaid, draw.io and Excalidraw sources, and exports SVG or PNG.
contains: output: one self-contained HTML + SVG file
imports Mermaid, draw.io and Excalidraw; exports SVG or PNG
